text:
meera: bringing up sentinel-9b int6 experimental run. finished smoke + a 2k-slice GTN pass. need routing, fallback, and GTN guidance.

ash: drop the headline numbers pls

meera: int6 p50 39ms p95 205ms (4k batching), throughput ~690 tok/s. est cost $0.0028 per 1k tokens vs int8 baseline $0.0064 per 1k tokens (~56% cheaper).

pavel: big cost win. any noticeable quality regressions?

meera: GTN slices (2k): overall accuracy -0.5% abs, multi-hop QA -1.6%, code-edit hallucination +1.2%, entity recall on low-frequency names -0.9%. token-level ppl rises after 900 tokens.

zoe: multi-hop QA regressions are concerning for some search/product flows. where do hallucinations show up? examples?

meera: mainly in incremental code edits (off-by-one loops) and legal clause paraphrase where numerics get dropped. posted redacted diffs: https://gist.github.com/redwood/sentinel9b-int6-diffs (redacted)

ops-bot: candidate sentinel-9b-int6 smoke -> metrics: cost_down, latency_tail_up, error_rate stable at ts=3632109950

ash: routing idea: hybrid default int6; explicit high-assurance tags (billing/legal/contract-extracts) -> int8; add code prompt classifier and context-length cutoff > 1000 -> int8. start conservative.

pavel: suggest confidence fallback too: compute cheap surprisal aggregate per-response; if mean_surprisal > threshold or token_uncertainty high -> rerun on int8 (cheap ensemble/rerank). Helps protect edge cases.

zoe: detection budget: regex/keyword for code + small distilled classifier for contract/billing. start with heuristics, collect labels, iterate. Also cap max_tokens to 1024 on int6 to avoid KV thrash.

meera: agree. ops checklist: 1) create flag sentinel-int6-canary 2) implement routing hook (flow_tag + code_prob + context_len) 3) export mean_surprisal & token_uncertainty metrics 4) enable shadowing for 60% for 72h then 10% live to non-high-assurance short-context flows

ash: GTN needs a compact deliverable for PMs: one CSV with slices + a one-pager. CSV columns proposal: flow_slice, sample_n, metric_name, int8_value, int6_value, delta_abs, pct_delta, pass_threshold, routing_decision, biz_risk_note. include top 8 worst diffs.

pavel: add a small ROI calc for product teams: assume 200M tokens/mo -> estimate monthly savings and expected quality impact on revenue-sensitive slices. PMs like numbers.

zoe: monitoring and alerts: alert if hallucination_delta > +1.0% OR p95 > +12% OR rerun_rate > 1% sustained over 30m. auto-fallback on any high-severity hallucination signal and capture sample to S3.

meera: technical note: attention-head saliency shifts observed on coref pronouns; may be fixed by tiny bias-correction or MLP rescaling later. mark as follow-up.

ops-bot: flag created: sentinel-int6-canary. baseline snapshots saved.

pavel: rollout timeline: week1 - shadow 60% for 72h + collect confidence distrib; week2 - implement rerun path and ops dashboards; week3 Mon - start 10% live non-high-assurance short-context with conditional rerun; review at 7d, expand to 35% if stable.

azoe: product voice note: "Introducing a cost-optimized inference tier for everyday workloads. Fidelity tier preserved for critical flows; routing is automatic. See migration guide and pricing examples." GTN will prepare messaging.

meera: I'll assemble CSV + one-pager + 10 redacted worst samples and post tomorrow morning. ops, please provision dashboards: latency_by_variant, hallucination_rate_by_slice, mean_surprisal_hist, rerun_rate, fallback_rate.

ash: tiny ask: include a small ablation where we tried deterministic decoding on int6 (temp=0.0) - it reduced hallucinations by ~0.3% on some slices but increased generic terse outputs. include as mitigation.

meera: noted. thanks all. will post artifacts and flag when ready. :thumbsup:
